name: Onna Doushi no Keiyaku Kekkon kara Hajimaru Koi
original_name: 女同士の契約結婚から始まる恋
source:
A very ordinary protagonist who works at a bookstore decides to get married by contract with a beautiful boss she met by chance on the day she was kicked out by her boyfriend! The beginning must have been a contract marriage...

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230116041448/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.kisswoman]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在书店工作的平凡主角，在被男友赶出家门的那天，决定与偶然邂逅的美女社长契约结婚！明明最开始只是契约结婚才对……

[整编自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230116041448/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.kisswoman]Google Play[/url]]
